programs.name: CIF Fitness Centre Hours
programs.description:
NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED - CIF Fitness Centre is available for you to utilize cardio or strength equipment. The daily hours are available for all Campus Recreation members.
**Please Note**
- Users should use spray bottles and rags in order to clean equipment - we advise prior to and post use
- All users must have a valid Campus Recreation membership to utilize the Fitness Centre space.
- Proper gym attire is recommended.
- Priority will be given on a first come first service basis
- Facility staff reserve the right to not allow these activities.
Furthermore, note that days and times are subject to change. Participants should check each schedule before coming to the facility.

programs.name: Open Rec Badminton
programs.description:
NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED - Open Recreation Badminton is designed to maximize participation, and to accommodate all types of badminton users. Come with a group of friends, or by yourself, to meet new players and find an open court. The idea is that participants will self-regulate games, and ensure maximum participation. Open rec badminton is for ALL levels and everyone should feel comfortable participating.
**Please Note**
- All users must have a valid Campus Recreation membership to utilize the Open Recreation space.
- Valid Campus Recreation members may rent Raquets for daily use at the service desks of any respective facility. New birdies are available for sale. Used birdies if available are free.
- Proper gym attire is required, including non-marking soled shoes.
- Priority will be given on a first come first service basis
- Facility staff reserve the right to not allow these activities.
- No glass bottles will be permitted into the court space
Furthermore, note that days and times are subject to change. Participants should check each schedule before coming to the facility.

programs.name: Swimming - Family Rec
programs.description:
NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED -
Take a break with your friends or family and enjoy the PAC pool. Swim, play basketball! Two lanes are available lengths swim, with the majority of the pool and the diving well open for recreation and play.
Children under 18 years of age may swim at the Family Rec Swims on Saturdays and Sundays when accompanied by their participating adult member. Non-members are required to pay for a guest pass and be accompanied by the member.
To provide the safest and most enjoyable environment, we've established a facility swim test that is administered to children under 10, who will be provided with a wristband to indicate their pool access level. The PAC Pool Admission Policy applies to all swims.

programs.name: Swimming - Fitness and Rec
programs.description:
NO REGISTRATION REQUIRED - Take a break with your friends and enjoy the PAC pool. Swim or play basketball! Six lanes are available for Fast, Medium and Recreational swimming and the diving well is open. Please follow the "Lane Swim Etiquette" as posted on the wall of the pool for the safety and enjoyment of all participants.
- All users must have a valid Campus Recreation membership to utilize the Open Recreation space.
To provide a safe and enjoyable environment, we utilize circle swimming when in a lane with another person. When selecting a lane, we encourage you to check the speed of the lane before entering.
Before attending a pool time, please check the cancellations list at the bottom of the page (the dates marked in red) to ensure the swim time is still available.
